title: Why Do We Need Human Mathematicians Anymore?
summary: Fields Medal winner Terence Tao reflects on the evolving role of human mathematicians in an era where AI and computational tools are becoming increasingly capable of solving complex mathematical problems. The article explores whether traditional mathematical research by humans remains necessary and what unique value human mathematicians bring to the field.
problem_solved: Addresses the existential question about the continued relevance of human mathematicians in the age of AI-assisted problem solving.
why_valuable: Provides authoritative perspective from a top mathematician on navigating the intersection of human creativity and machine computation in mathematical research.
